wp_pk_buyer_leads.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_buyer_leads` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `phone_hash` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `phone_encrypted` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `first_seen_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `opt_out_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE
) STRICT

wp_pk_interest_events.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_interest_events` (

  `reference_code` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `property_snapshot` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `provider_message_id` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `created_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL
) STRICT

wp_pk_contact_limits.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_contact_limits` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `lead_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `day_key` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `contacts_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0'
) STRICT

wp_pk_contact_disclosures.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_contact_disclosures` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `lead_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,

) STRICT

wp_pk_whatsapp_consents.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_whatsapp_consents` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `lead_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,

  `granted_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE,

wp_pk_whatsapp_messages.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_whatsapp_messages` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

  `lead_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,

  `message_type` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `created_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL
) STRICT

wp_pk_buyer_preferences.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_buyer_preferences` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `lead_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `budget_max` INTEGER,
  `areas` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `layout_value` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `transaction_value` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `source` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL
) STRICT

wp_pk_lead_followups.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_lead_followups` (
  `lead_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `status` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  `note` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE,
  `updated_by` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `updated_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lead_id`)
) STRICT
